purpose: Teach: 吸着/触発/技量/施術/力説/肝炎/訪米/致死

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、汚染物質の吸着技術を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on adsorption technology for pollutants, didn't you?
lines.style: Measured, professional tone. Genuinely curious—actually paying attention to his work. Slight upward lilt at the end, inviting confirmation. Open, unhurried.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、芸術運動の触発要因を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote about the factors that sparked the art movement.
lines.style: Quiet, careful delivery. Slight hesitation before answering, like he's making sure he's heard correctly. Straightforward but a little uncertain—checking himself.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、伝統工芸の技量継承を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, and you covered the passing down of traditional craft skills in your paper, right?
lines.style: Warm, reflective tone. Not quizzing him—genuinely reflecting on what she's learned about his interests. Gentle pause before his name. Encouraging.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、古代の医療施術記録を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I focused on records of medical practices in ancient times.
lines.style: Steady voice, polite correction underlying it. Not defensive, just factual. A small breath before answering—he's used to being corrected gently.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、論文で人権の重要性を力説しましたね
lines.en: Ren, you really drove home the importance of human rights in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Engaged, genuinely moved tone. She's registering something meaningful he said. Direct eye contact in the voice. Affirming.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、肝炎ウイルスの流行史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote about the historical spread of hepatitis viruses.
lines.style: Quiet, steady delivery. No defensiveness—he's just stating the facts of what he actually studied. Brief pause, like he's resigned to the pattern.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、首脳の訪米史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, and you covered the history of prime ministers' visits to the United States, correct?
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly puzzled tone. She's still trying to understand his actual research. Reflective, not accusatory. A little slower.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、毒物の致死量研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, my research was on lethal dosage studies of toxic substances.
lines.style: Flat, matter-of-fact close. Resigned acceptance. No inflection left. He's said this enough times. The words just fall out.
